title: Session 1 — Participant 3 User + Claude Behavior Graph
goal: Produce the August 2026 BluShark Digital internal Reef Report newsletter sections (Events/Activities and Celebrations) as MailChimp-ready HTML, configure and send the campaign in MailChimp, and update the BSD MailChimp Analytics newsletter tracker spreadsheet with July and August 2026 performance data for the Legal Leads and Legal Clients segments — all completed within a single Claude chat session.
context:
At BluShark Digital, a Washington D.C.-based law firm SEO and marketing agency, I produce the internal monthly employee newsletter known as the "Reef Report" and maintain the agency's newsletter performance analytics. This session covers two interconnected workflows completed within a single Claude chat session. The first is the HTML production of two internal newsletter sections for the August 2026 Reef Report — the Events/Activities section and the Celebrations section — both built using table-based HTML with inline CSS and strict formatting rules (600px max width, no rounded corners, square edges, fixed cell heights, consistent font sizes). The second is a data entry and tracking workflow: pulling live campaign performance metrics from MailChimp for the Legal Leads segment (July and August 2026) and the Legal Clients segment (August 2026), and entering that data into the BSD MailChimp Analytics newsletter tracker spreadsheet. Both workflows rely on Claude as an AI assistant throughout research, content generation, HTML build, data organization, and quality review.

session_goal_achievement.Why or why not: The goal was successfully achieved. Generating newsletter sections with Claude for monthly Mailchimp campaigns is a recurring task that requires thorough organization and multi-source data structuring. This session focused on demonstrating the build process for specific email sections, as well as the post-send workflow for pulling, organizing, and analyzing performance data from Mailchimp's monthly reports.

Step 1.step_name: Gather and organize content inputs for the August Reef Report sections
Step 1.step_action: Collect all raw inputs needed to populate the two internal newsletter sections: (1) the Activities/Events section listing BluShark team events for August, and (2) the Celebrations section covering employee birthdays and work anniversaries for the month. Organize these into a working content list to guide both the copy drafting and HTML build.

Iterate with Claude to correct any layout issues identified during review.

Step 4.step_name: Pull MailChimp newsletter performance data and enter it into the Google Sheets tracker

Enter all extracted data into the corresponding tabs of the BSD MailChimp Analytics newsletter tracker spreadsheet (BSD_Mailchimp_Analytics_-_Newsletter_Data.xlsx), maintaining the existing column structure and row formatting. Use Claude to assist with organizing the data entry and flagging any anomalies.
